The defendant submitted the requisite documents with the plaintiff bank including self attested copy of PAN Card, original electricity bill, self attested copy of udyog aadhar memorandum, self attested copy of license issued by department of food safety which have been placed on record as Mark D, Exhibit PW1/3, Mark E and Mark F respectively.

On submission of the said application of the defendant and documents, the plaintiff bank is stated to have sanctioned the loan of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) at an interest @ 9.65% per annum on floating basis with monthly rests , vide original sanction communication DOC 2-140,
placed on record as Exhibit PW-1/4.

6. Considering the above, the inevitable inference is that the plaintiff has been able to prove that the defendant is liable to pay a sum of Rs. Rs.58,692.78/- (Rupees Fifty-Eight Thousand Six Hundred Ninety Two and Sevety-Eight Paisa Only) to the plaintiff bank.

The plaintiff claims pendente lite and future interest from the date of filing of the present suit till realization of the decreetal amount as per the current applicable rate of 9.40% per annum with monthly rests and penal interest as per contractual rate of 2% per annum.

Keeping in view that there was a commercial transaction between the parties, in exercise of the discretion under Section 34 of CPC, this Court awards pendente lite and future interest from the date of filing of the suit till the date of the decree at the rate of 7.5% per annum instead of interest @9.40% per annum with monthly rests and penal interest of 2%, which appears to be exorbitant and unreasonable.

7. Thus, the suit of the plaintiff bank is decreed for a sum of Rs. Rs.58,692.78/- (Rupees Fifty-Eight Thousand Six Hundred Ninety Two and Sevety-Eight Paisa Only) with pendente lite and future interest @ 7.5% per annum from the date of filing of the suit till the date of the decree, penal interest @ 2% and costs of the suit of Rs.5,000/-(Rupees Five Thousand Only).
Decree Sheet be prepared accordingly.
